page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.16xlarge is a storage and memory-optimized server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its integrated local storage, which consists of 15358 GB of local solid-state drive (SSD) capacity. This massive local storage volume is bundled directly with the instance, eliminating the need for external network-attached storage for primary workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, supporting high-throughput data transfers.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2ne.16xlarge offers a high density of local SSD storage and RAM relative to its compute resources, making it a viable option for workloads requiring large-scale local data caching and high-speed memory access without the overhead of external storage arrays. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance. This hardware profile is suited for large-scale databases, high-performance storage nodes, big data analytics, and memory-intensive transactional applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.16xlarge is a storage and memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. A key hardware highlight is the inclusion of 15358 GB of local SSD storage, which provides high-capacity, low-latency local data access. Network performance is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps. Lacking dedicated GPUs, this instance is designed for non-accelerated, data-heavy workloads. The combination of high-capacity local SSD storage, dedicated compute cores, and substantial memory makes this instance highly suitable for large-scale databases, transactional systems, and data-intensive analytical workloads.
